independent_local_checks.not_performed: No fresh local full-audio scoring or subjective audition.

measurement_limitations.process_peak_rss_bytes: Raw RUSAGE_SELF.ru_maxrss may inherit a parent launch-time high-water floor across exec. Both models report 7902781440 bytes; not a valid isolated CPU memory comparison. CUDA counters are separate and reset per model repeat.
measurement_limitations.upstream_training_overlap: Unresolved; training-pool AAC screen, not an unbiased held-out HQ leaderboard.
